label: LORD_2: causes the being of everything else and governs everything else
term: lord, typed by its grounds (Dominus caeli et terrae; Lean `IsLordByCauseAndGovernment`)
definition: IsLordByCauseAndGovernment InAct CausesIn esse Governs g: g causes the being of every other being in act as to being (IsCreatorOfAll, definition 92c03350) and governs every other being in act as to being (GovernsAllOthers: Governs g x for each such x, with Governs the q.103 relation of definition c53b5fbe, government as directing the governed to an end consisting in some good). After ST I q.13 a.7 (Lord is said of God relative to creatures, which are subject to him) and q.103 (God governs all things). Example: on the stage-two route, a being with the nine, given the open bridge that an intellectual and willing cause of the being of all directs each other thing to an end and the q.103 a.3 reading that directing is governing. Counterexample: a cause of the being of everything else that directs nothing to any end (Control.Controls part 2 of DeiFiliusLordBlessed: such a being is not LORD_2); a governor who did not cause the being of what it governs (a human ruler). Distinguished from LORD_1 (the primitive Primitives.IsLord, authority to dispose of what is subject to one): LORD_2 types power to cause and to direct, not a right or authority, and does not type conservation as a separate conjunct (CausesIn esse has no time index, so causing being and keeping in being are not distinguished in this vocabulary; per se conservation, definition 56989bd0, is itself without motion or time; no identification is asserted).
note: Analyst reading, attribution deferred: the Summa articles (q.13 a.7, q.22 a.2, q.103 a.3, q.104 a.1) motivate it; no claim states it. Sibling of LORD_1 (disambiguation aa1de96a); the only passage between them is the open sense bridge 'Whatever is LORD_2 is LORD_1'. Structural properties: none built in; the creator conjunct is contained by definition in the case's supreme goodness (DEF-SUPREMELY-GOOD), not independently warranted.
